task.instructions:
Using matplotlib, draw a line chart of daily site visits over one week and call out the busiest day.
The seven days and their visit counts, in order, are:
Mon 310, Tue 288, Wed 352, Thu 412, Fri 366, Sat 240, Sun 205.
Put the three-letter day names along the x axis, in that order, and the visit counts on the y axis.
Add a text annotation reading exactly `Peak: 412 visits`, pointing at Thursday's value. Place the annotation text itself in data coordinates at x = 3.0, y = 430.0 (Thursday is category index 3); anywhere within 0.6 in x and 35 in y of that point counts as correct. An arrow from the text to the point is welcome but not required.
Start the y axis at zero.
Give the chart a title and label both axes.
